scalars.scalar_value: Minimum five (5) years experience in an acute care facility laboratory working in 2-3 sections of the Laboratory or seven (7+) or more years working 1-2 sections.

items.item_text: Minimum five (5) years experience in an acute care facility laboratory working in 2-3 sections of the Laboratory or seven (7+) or more years working 1-2 sections.
Internal candidate promotions based on total experience job performance as a CLS-II and potential for success as a CLS-III.

Interacts with physician, nurses, ward clerks, phlebotomists, other clinical laboratory scientists and other health care professionals in the resolution of problems involving patient specimen collection and handling, appropriateness of specimens, clarification of orders and result reporting.

Consults with Clinical Laboratory Scientists, Laboratory Supervisors, Administrative Director of Laboratory Services, Medical Director of Laboratory Services, or Pathologists for policy clarification and problem resolution.

Specimen Processing and Testing • Receives, processes and tests patient samples within established timelines. • Performs routine and specialized procedures in all areas as assigned following procedure in SOP manual for that area.

Quality Control and Proficiency Testing • Receives, processes, tests and documents results of proficiency test samples in the same manner as patient specimens. • Performs required quality control testing and documentation, and follows established guidelines for corrective action when results are not within the established acceptable levels of performance.
